    r0=min(r for r,c in cells);r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells);c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    colors={g[r][c] for r,c in cells}
    inner=min(colors,key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    rr=[r for r,c in cells if g[r][c]==inner];cc=[c for r,c in cells if g[r][c]==inner]
    dr=max(1,(max(rr)-min(rr)+1));dc=max(1,(max(cc)-min(cc)+1))
    for r in range(max(0,r0-dr),min(len(g),r1+dr+1)):
